stories.title: Bridgewater leaves Lions to likely retire again
stories.summary: Quarterback Teddy Bridgewater is stepping away from the Detroit Lions and is retiring from the NFL, coach Dan Campbell said Sunday.

stories.title: Sources: Commanders' Tunsil suffers torn triceps
stories.summary: Washington Commanders left tackle Laremy Tunsil suffered a torn triceps in practice, will likely require surgery and will miss at least a significant portion of the regular season, a source told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo and Steve Wyche on Saturday.

stories.title: Cunningham calls Carrington's foul 'unnecessary'
stories.summary: The Sky's DiJonai Carrington was assessed a flagrant 2 and ejected Saturday after a hard foul across the face and neck area of Fever guard Sophie Cunningham.

stories.title: No. 1 Sinner (knee) withdraws from Cincinnati
stories.summary: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner on Sunday said he's dealing with a bothersome right knee and will not play in the Cincinnati Open.

stories.title: Panthers sign Trask as QB3 after King injury
stories.summary: The Panthers signed Kyle Trask as a third quarterback on Sunday with Hall of Fame game hero Haynes King expected to miss time with a hamstring injury.
